Prerequisite(s): —

Benefit: As a melee touch attack, by spending a mote of time, the time mage can temporarily remove a creature from time altogether. The target creature must make a Fortitude save (DC 10 + half of the time mage's level + his Intelligence modifier) or is inflicted with the banished status effect, vanishing completely for a number of rounds equal to half the time mage's level. No magic can detect the creature during this time, as it exists outside of time and space—in effect, the creature ceases to exist for the duration of this ability. At the end of the duration, the creature reappears unharmed in the space it last occupied (or the nearest possible space, if the original space is now occupied).
